SELECT
    o.name AS org_name,
    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.amount,
    i.due_date
FROM invoices i
JOIN organizations o ON i.org_id = o.id
WHERE i.is_paid = false
  AND i.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY i.amount DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

SELECT
    o.org_name,
    i.invoice_id,
    i.amount,
    i.due_date
FROM
    invoices i
    JOIN organizations o ON i.organization_id = o.organization_id
WHERE
    i.due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND CURRENT_DATE
    AND i.status = 'unpaid'
ORDER BY
    i.amount DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

*Assumptions:*
- `status = 'unpaid'` identifies unpaid invoices (alternatively, `paid_date IS NULL` works if no explicit status column).
- "Top 10" is interpreted as the 10 largest unpaid amounts within the last 30 days.
- "Last 30 days" refers to the `due_date` falling between 30 days ago and today (inclusive).
